Initializes a new ChargerAstronomyShared.Contracts.Models.SkyRegion, a rectangular region of the sky defined by right ascension and declination.

public SkyRegion(double raMinHours, double raMaxHours, double decMinDeg, double decMaxDeg)

Parameters

raMinHours double

The minimum right ascension (RA) boundary, in hours. Must be in the range [0, 24).

raMaxHours double

The maximum right ascension (RA) boundary, in hours. Must be in the range (0, 24] and greater than or equal to raMinHours.

decMinDeg double

The minimum declination (Dec) boundary, in degrees. Must be in the range [-90, 90].

decMaxDeg double

The maximum declination (Dec) boundary, in degrees. Must be in the range [-90, 90] and greater than or equal to decMinDeg.

Exceptions

ArgumentOutOfRangeException

Thrown if raMinHours is not in the range [0, 24), or if raMaxHours is not in the range (0, 24]. Thrown if decMinDeg or decMaxDeg is not in the range [-90, 90].

ArgumentException

Thrown if raMinHours is greater than raMaxHours, or if decMinDeg is greater than decMaxDeg.
